name: TIPMine permissionless mine() burns TIP from the TIP/SOL pair and syncs
summary: TIPMine.mine() has no caller check, and on its first run releases 2% of the TIP allocation by having the TIP token burn and push TIP straight out of the TIP/SOL PancakeSwap pair and sync it, collapsing the pair's TIP reserve. The attacker bought TIP, called mine() so the pair's TIP reserve fell from about 2e9 to 53,839 while its SOL stayed, and sold the TIP back for the pair's SOL.
notes: TIPMine's reset is the owner setting initialTotalSupply, which mine() requires and which sizes each release, after the token, pair and recipient wiring; TIP's is naming TIPMine its miningContract, which grants burnFromPool. mine() had never run (lastMineTime 0).

Loss is the pair's Binance-Peg SOL (priced by DefiLlama, despite the PoC calling it illiquid); about 48 SOL of it went to the TIP-ecosystem pools' flash-loan premiums. The pair's TIP is valued at nothing (rule 12).
